source_identity: NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily observed-weather reconstruction inputs

station_observation_request.station_id_rule: Only station IDs selected by the frozen reconstruction manifest may be requested.

reconstruction_contract.target_grid: 1 degree latitude x 1 degree longitude for Richman-Lamb-style Tier C reconstruction where that literature geography is required
candidate_ranking: distance to the predeclared target location
reconstruction_contract.substitution: Freeze primary, secondary and tertiary station lineage before market-outcome access; use secondary/tertiary observations only for eligible primary gaps.
reconstruction_contract.quality_control: Honor NOAA measurement and quality flags. Exclusions and substitutions must be deterministic and outcome-blind.
reconstruction_contract.temperature_units: Normalize GHCN-Daily TMAX/TMIN from tenths of degrees C to degrees C before derived calculations.
reconstruction_contract.daily_mean: Use (TMAX + TMIN) / 2 when a source-study-compatible daily mean must be derived and both values are valid.
reconstruction_contract.source_study_climatology: For each calendar day and target year, use the prior 30 years of bound observed temperature under the same frozen station/substitution rule; do not substitute fixed 1991-2020 normals.
reconstruction_contract.modern_robustness_climatology: NOAA U.S. Daily Climate Normals 1991-2020 may be used only as Tier D robustness and must carry that label.
reconstruction_contract.missing_original_metadata_rule: Missing original Richman-Lamb seed/export or move-history detail downgrades fidelity to Tier C; it does not block deterministic NOAA reconstruction and must not be repaired using outcome information.

fidelity_policy.upgrade_rule: Upgrade only when higher-fidelity original artifact or seed/station lineage is actually recovered and hash-bound.
